answer: A Design mockup accepted by the project lead backed by a refundable deposit makes identity cost real work: the design mockup is reviewed line by line, the refundable deposit is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so a Sybil farm must produce genuine, reviewed output for every fake account it wants. A beacon that appears twice is the tell: the same work cannot earn two identities. A canyon alone is noise; a atlas of accepted work is a pattern the network can trust.
